title: AI‑Agent Convergence: Multi‑Cloud, Governance, and Industry‑Specific Innovations Shape Cloud Landscape (Nov 2026)
core_insight: AI‑agent platforms are becoming the central competitive edge, driving convergence of multi‑cloud services, industry‑specific AI workloads, and heightened compliance controls across both Western and Chinese cloud providers.

dimension_texts.technology: AWS推出ECS Gateway简化容器入口网络，Lambda Web Functions拉近Web代码与无服务器计算的距离；Google Cloud在BigQuery和Looker引入AI‑agent可观测性，实现数据层和分析层的原生治理；Azure扩展AI‑agent生态，推出Foundry Agent Service和Copilot harness，强化多模态AI原生工作负载。 AWS发布AI驱动的Continuum代码漏洞检测服务，GPT‑6.1在Bedrock上可用，S3 Tables支持Apache Iceberg迁移；Google Cloud实现从BigQuery到AlloyDB的逆向ETL并加入自主AI威胁检测；Azure引入硬件审计日志的Cloud HSM，推出针对EDA工作负载的Cobalt 200 VM，提升安全合规与专用计算能力。 Introducing Amazon ECS Gateway: A fully-managed ingress solution for ECS services AWS Weekly Roundup: AWS Lambda Web Functions, Amazon S3 on the Vercel Marketplace, and more AWS Continuum for code vulnerabilities is now generally available New AI agent observability and governance across BigQuery and Looker Powering agentic cloud governance: What's new in Organization Policy
